name: ribosomal protein S26

function.text: RPS26 encodes small ribosomal subunit protein eS26. Annotated molecular activities include structural constituent of ribosome and cadherin binding. It participates in negative regulation of RNA splicing and translation.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to Diamond-Blackfan anemia 10 (autosomal dominant).

somatic.text: This gene is included in cancer-panel definitions, but a disease-specific somatic association has not been assigned from the alteration-context sources reviewed for this draft.

germline_associations.mechanism: Autosomal dominant; definitive GenCC assertion from G2P. Allele-specific mechanism requires review.

selection_reason: Panel membership; user authorized the complete proposed and reserve roster.
